requirement: Undoing a WordPress look write that created the site's Additional CSS post deletes that post instead of leaving it empty

oracle.ref: PR #1100 (fix); fix evidence: uiweekwp 09/10/2026: no custom_css post before look.set; after look.set + turn undo the site has post 2093 'wp-tracy-business' with empty content (created 18:17:28 by the write, emptied 18:18:00 by the undo); undo entry f737fe has c0 = 0 bytes and no way to tell 'none' from 'empty'.
oracle.invariant: S1 exits 0. A site with no custom_css post: the read says exists:false, the undo entry records customCss.existed:false, and look.revert (and a LOOK_SET_NO_EFFECT put-back) sends mode 'remove' — the post the write created is gone afterwards, restored ['Additional CSS']. tracy-host's turn undo of such an entry sends mode 'remove' with expect = sha256 of c1, and the check then reads now == before. An entry kept before `existed` was recorded (c0 empty, no flag) is put back as an empty post, as before; the plugin and tracy-host copies of WP_CUSTOM_CSS_PHP stay identical.
